spans.s:
(इ) मिवि r. 1st cl. (मिन्वति)
1 To sprinkle or moisten.
2 (According to some authorities,) To serve, to gratify by service.

r. 1st cl. (मीवति)
To be large or corpulent.

f. (-वा)
The worm of the intestines, Ascarides, &c.
E.
मी to hurt, Uṇādi aff. वा.

m. (-वा)
Air, wind.
E.
मी to move, वन् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Mischievous, hurting, killing.
E.
मी to hurt or kill, ष्वरच् Uṇādi aff.
